header: Price per unit, row by row
lead: One row per billable unit, with its rate and a line on how it is counted. The table adds nothing up.
note: The note holds the billing terms: when units are counted, how they appear on the invoice and whether tax is included.

rates.title: The unit is the row header
rates.text: So screen readers announce which unit each rate belongs to.

rates.title: The rate keeps its own column
rates.text: Figures use equal widths, so the decimal points line up.

rates.title: How it is counted is the third column
rates.text: A clear counting rule prevents disputes about the invoice later.

rates.title: No total row
rates.text: Totals belong on the invoice, not in this table.
